header.source: NSE closing price (end of day, not live); 52-week range computed from daily highs and lows (NSE bhavcopy)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Eicher Motors (NSE: EICHERMOT) makes and sells motorcycles and automotive components; its consolidated revenue in FY26 was ₹23,408 crore.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: In the quarter to 30 Sep 2026, revenue was ₹7,422 crore, 20.3% more than a year earlier; the operating margin was 20.2% against 21.3%, and profit attributable to shareholders was ₹1,573 crore, 14.9% higher.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: On 16 Nov 2026, the first session after the result, EICHERMOT shares fell 0.67% while the NIFTY 50 rose 0.58% and the NIFTY AUTO index fell 1.29%; allowing for the market's move, EICHERMOT's own move was -1.52%, about 1.16 times its usual daily variation.

claims.label: UNCERTAIN
claims.text: These numbers measure the move, not its cause: the result, the autos sector's fall and any other news that day overlap, and nothing here separates them.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: At ₹7,599 (NSE close, 16 Nov 2026), a discounted cash flow model with a 13.06% cost of capital does not reach the price at any revenue growth up to 30% a year for five years at the FY26 operating margin of 21.1%; with revenue growing at its FY23–FY26 rate of 17.5%, it does at an operating margin of 47.6%.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: With the other assumptions at base, the valuation is most sensitive to the cost of capital (one percentage point either way: a model value of ₹3,245 to ₹4,139 a share) and to how long EICHERMOT keeps earning high returns on new investment (anywhere from returns equal to its cost of capital to a quarter above its past level: a model value of ₹3,029 to ₹3,665 a share); the Q3 FY27 result will be the next reported quarter.

prices.note: Each series is rebased to 100 on the first common session. Raw exchange prices are not published here (NSE terms).

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.definition: Price × shares outstanding (share capital ÷ ₹1 face value at 2026-09-30).

metrics.label: P/E (TTM)
metrics.definition: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four reported quarters (Q3 FY26 – Q2 FY27).

metrics.label: EV / EBIT (TTM)
metrics.definition: Enterprise value (market cap − the net cash and treasury figure below) ÷ operating profit over the last four quarters.

metrics.label: Net cash and treasury
metrics.definition: Cash, bank balances and treasury investments, plus investments in joint ventures and associates, less lease liabilities, borrowings, preference shares and minority interests, at 30 Sep 2026.

metrics.label: Operating margin (FY26)
metrics.definition: EBIT ÷ revenue, after depreciation, excluding other income. Sites that quote an EBITDA-based margin show a higher figure.

metrics.label: ROE (FY26)
metrics.definition: Profit for the year ÷ total equity at year end.

metrics.label: ROIC (FY26)
metrics.definition: After-tax EBIT ÷ invested capital at the start of the year. Invested capital excludes about ₹12k crore of cash and treasury, which is why it looks so high.

metrics.label: Revenue growth FY23–FY26
metrics.definition: Compound annual growth of revenue from FY23 to FY26.

metrics.label: Cash conversion (FY26)
metrics.definition: Operating cash flow ÷ profit for the year.

metrics.label: Beta vs NIFTY 50
metrics.definition: Sensitivity of EICHERMOT's daily return to the NIFTY 50's, over the two years to the price date.

flags.title: The price is beyond what the model can reach
flags.text: The model cannot reach the price at any revenue growth up to 30% a year, so the page says 'more than 30%' instead of forcing a number. This is a statement about the model's range and assumptions, not a forecast and not a view on the shares.

flags.title: The exchange's files contain errors
flags.text: 16 reconciliation checks fail on the exchange's own files, each with a recorded reason. They are marked as explained, not passed, and the figure as filed is used, never a corrected one.

flags.title: A joint venture is not consolidated line by line
flags.text: Eicher files its Volvo Eicher joint venture under the equity method, so its profit enters as a share of profit and its assets as an investment.

limitations: Template A (non-financial, positive free cash flow). Single-stage fade model; no currency driver.
Cash flows are discounted to the balance-sheet date, 30 Sep 2026, two months before the price date; the model does not roll that gap forward, so its values are slightly low against the price.
Debt is borrowings plus lease liabilities; earmarked bank balances are counted as cash, which overstates cash slightly.
The risk-free rate is a twelve-month average while the price and equity risk premium are point-in-time.
The event study measures the size of a move, not its cause; five results days are too few for statistical claims.
Eicher Motors files its Volvo Eicher joint venture under the equity method, so the joint venture's profit enters as a share of profit and its assets as an investment, not line by line.

Eicher's XBRL files carry the other comprehensive income under 'total comprehensive income attributable to owners' in every filing; the check on that split is shown as explained, and the item is not used.

From FY23 the figures come from the exchange XBRL filings; the owners' share of profit for FY22 and FY23 and the lease liabilities for FY23 to FY25 come from the results PDFs (text layers checked against the printed subtotals and the XBRL).
Eicher reported its September 2026 quarter after the market closed on 13 November 2026, so its price reaction is measured on the next session.

At the valuation date the model does not reach the share price at any revenue growth inside the range it searches at the latest operating margin. That is a statement about the model's range and assumptions, not a view on the shares.
Static page: prices are end-of-day as of the date shown, not live.
